propositions: CLI facade reconstruction via 19 overlapping frozensets and regex-based reference generator creates maintenance burden and syntax authority drift between parser and generated help.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help; rebar help <command> reports them unknown while handler-owned --help is inconsistent and can execute work.
One side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory per command grammar must serve both runtime execution and build-time generation to eliminate manual syntax authority.
Generated package-help and overview bytes must be committed and runtime-authoritative, consumed before operation/config/mount/handler boundaries to ensure help stays pre-operation.
Lazy route registry with canonical identity, spellings, visibility, handler/parser references, and semantic capabilities replaces overlapping frozensets and intercept ladder.
Exact aliases, historical spellings (jira-onboard), hidden commands (bridge-status), and retired commands (purge-bridge) must preserve compatibility contracts and behavioral parity.
